_comment: check_plan_deferral_citations rule (docs/INVOCATION_TOPOLOGY_PLAN.md T4). Each entry means: a
human read the flagged paragraph and confirmed it is not a plan making its own new, untracked
scope cut -- it is prose narrating an investigation into a PRE-EXISTING claim (project memory,
an older governance file), or referencing an item that is already extensively tracked elsewhere
in the SAME document under a local task id (e.g. G1, T7) that doesn't match the REG-nn/B-nn
citation shape this rule looks for. The key is a fingerprint of the doc name + normalized
paragraph text, so editing the paragraph invalidates the exemption and it resurfaces for
re-review -- do not pre-clear anything speculatively.

90d3669cc2dd.why: docs/CLOSEOUT_PLAN.md risk-register row about G1 (revoke exposed token) getting deferred again -- G1 is itself a fully tracked, named task in this same plan (its own section, its own DoD, owner-only flag called out repeatedly); 'deferred' here is a future-risk verb about G1, not a new untracked scope cut.

8d84976b4229.why: docs/FINAL_OPEN_ITEMS_PLAN.md F11's own Definition of Done checklist ('At least one bounded-context / roadmap question answered by evidence rather than deferred') -- F11 is named directly in this plan's own STATUS banner ('CLOSED except F11 (owner-only)'), the most prominent possible tracking a still-open item can have in this document; the unchecked box is F11 itself, not a separate silent deferral.
